arxiv-2308-05542.creator: Wongi Park, Inhyuk Park, Sungeun Kim, Jongbin Ryu
arxiv-2308-05542.description: Abstract In real medical data, training samples typically show long-tailed distributions with multiple labels. Class distribution of the medical data has a long-tailed shape, in which the incidence of different diseases is quite varied, and at the same time, it is not unusual for images taken from symptomatic patients to be multi-label diseases.

arxiv-2309-14079.title: Unitarity Bounds and Basis Transformations in SMEFT: An Analysis of Warsaw and SILH Bases
arxiv-2309-14079.creator: Qing-Hong Cao, Yandong Liu, Shu-Run Yuan
arxiv-2309-14079.description: Abstract The equivalence between the Warsaw and SILH bases in Standard Model Effective Field Theory is well established, with transformation rules connecting the two via equations of motion and field redefinitions. This study presents an explicit calculation of the analytical unitarity bounds—defined as the marginal limit of the parameter space—for dimension-six operators within both the Warsaw and SILH bases.

arxiv-2312-13104.title: Optimizing Ego Vehicle Trajectory Prediction: The Graph Enhancement Approach
arxiv-2312-13104.creator: Sushil Sharma, Aryan Singh, Ganesh Sistu, Mark Halton, Ciarán Eising
arxiv-2312-13104.description: Abstract Predicting the trajectory of an ego vehicle is a critical component of autonomous driving systems. Current state-of-the-art methods typically rely on Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) and sequential models to process front-view images for future trajectory prediction. However, these approaches often struggle with perspective issues affecting object features in the scene.

pmc-10632556.title: A case of bullous systemic lupus erythematosus: Diagnostic challenges and clinical implications
pmc-10632556.creator: Samikchhya Keshary Bhandari, Naveen Gautam, Anupama Pandeya, Saket Jha
pmc-10632556.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Key Clinical MessageSkin involvement in systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) is common. Bullous lesions in SLE patients are usually due to other autoimmune conditions or rarely, due to lupus itself. Bullous SLE is rare blistering disorder characterized by subepidermal blisters. We, hereby, present a case of bullous SLE in a 24‐year‐old female who responded well to systemic glucocorticoids, mycophenolate mofetil, and dapsone. INTRODUCTION Systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) is a complex autoimmune disease that affects multiple systems in the body.

pmc-11314019.title: Dynamic and Static Regulation of Nicotinamide Adenine Dinucleotide Phosphate: Strategies, Challenges, and Future Directions in Metabolic Engineering
pmc-11314019.creator: Nana Ding, Zenan Yuan, Lei Sun, Lianghong Yin, John C D’Auria
pmc-11314019.description: Reduced nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide phosphate (NADPH) is a crucial cofactor in metabolic networks. The efficient regeneration of NADPH is one of the limiting factors for productivity in biotransformation processes. To date, many metabolic engineering tools and static regulation strategies have been developed to regulate NADPH regeneration.

pmc-11486978.title: LSTM-based framework for predicting point defect percentage in semiconductor materials using simulated XRD patterns
pmc-11486978.creator: Mehran Motamedi, Reza Shidpour, Mehdi Ezoji
pmc-11486978.description: In this paper, we present a machine learning-based approach that leverages Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks combined with a sliding window technique for feature extraction, aimed at accurately predicting point defect percentages in semiconductor materials based on simulated X-ray Diffraction (XRD) data.

pmc-11621409.title: Analysis of queries to a Swedish drug information centre identifies scientific knowledge gaps
pmc-11621409.creator: Johan Nilsson, Jenny M Kindblom, Julia Izsak
pmc-11621409.description: Drug Information Centres (DICs) are providing clinicians with evidence-based support for rational drug treatment. However, knowledge gaps in the literature may hinder DICs from offering optimal guidance. This study examined the extent and nature of these knowledge gaps and their impact on clinical pharmacological advice, using real-world query data from a Swedish regional DIC.

pmc-11624738.description: BackgroundNutritional stress is a mechanism that allows tumor cells to evade the immune system. ARG deficiency in the tumor microenvironment can impair T-cell response while ARG supplementation may promote antitumor immune activity.

pmc-13182786.creator: Minsih, Coiriyah Widyasari, Ratnasari Diah Utami, Imam Mujahid, Alfi Laila, Saiful Afandi, Hanum Salsabila, Resti Yektyastuti, Lorena Jaramillo-Mediavilla, Ivana Roncevic, Rasmitadila Rasmitadila
pmc-13182786.description: BackgroundInclusive students with Specific Learning Disorder (SLD) often experience persistent challenges in acquiring foundational literacy skills due to the lack of adaptive and personalized instructional approaches. Artificial Intelligence (AI) game-based deep learning models offer a promising alternative by enabling individualized learning pathways and continuous feedback.

pmc-13266118.title: Endothelial injury is a central driver of systemic IFN-β toxicity and is reversible through Jak inhibition
pmc-13266118.creator: Lianwen Zhang, Linh Pham, Michael B Steele, Nathan Jenks, Rebecca Nace, Stephen J Russell, Kah-Whye Peng
pmc-13266118.description: Oncolytic viruses (OVs) encoding interferon beta (IFN-β) are under clinical evaluation. IFN-β is an attractive transgene due to its antiproliferative and immunomodulatory properties; however, the systemic effects of sustained IFN-β expression remain poorly defined. Here, we demonstrate that prolonged circulating IFN-β induces dose-dependent toxicity in murine models. Persistent IFN-β exposure led to elevated transaminases, thrombocytopenia, lymphopenia, and reduced hemoglobin.
